body: Diagnostic substrate (this session). False-veto sweep over eval/gittables/corpus_pass/columns.parquet, agreement columns (sense==ydf==X) as the 'truly X' proxy, per-label cap 3000, via scripts/apply_ydf_validation_gate.py load_validations()+evaluate(). Of 78 measurable typed validations: 40 clean (<2% veto), 23 at >=10%. TRIAGE — Group 1 too-strict (FIX, ac-01/02/03): timestamp.mdy_12h 98% (no :SS), timestamp.rfc_3339 94% (offset needs colon), time.iso 88% (frac must be 6 digits), time.hms_24h 36% (no frac allowed), component.year 23% (^\\d{4}$ rejects 1998.0), gender enum 22% (case), day_of_week enum 70% (case), continent enum 60% (mostly genuine mislabels+codes, case recovers only 7pp). Group 2 gate-working-correctly (LEAVE): government.ein 100% (77105464-1 not XX-XXXXXXX), commerce.isbn 39% (values are DOIs), banking.aba_routing 35% (10 digits not 9), time.hm_24h 45% ('304;1' junk), country_code 15% (JUS not ISO). Case-fold audit (13 enums): recovers day_of_week 51pp, gender 17pp, continent 7pp; booleans+country_code unchanged. 152 of 230 typed validations UNMEASURABLE (<30 agreement cols) — same rare-type starvation as spec 2026-06-04. See memory validation-gate-asymmetry.

Taxonomy follow-up (deferred from ac-01): seconds-bearing mdy_12h. The sweep's 98% false-veto on datetime.timestamp.mdy_12h is the form '06/30/2013 12:00:00 AM' (HH:MM:SS AM). Its format_string '%m/%d/%Y %I:%M %p' has no %S and strptime has no optional-seconds — so a seconds-bearing mdy_12h is a DISTINCT canonical format, not a regex widening. Needs a taxonomy decision (new type datetime.timestamp.mdy_12h_seconds, or a normalisation step), tracked separately. Same logic applies to any other format whose round-trip transform can't absorb the widened pattern — widen pattern only where format_string/transform round-trips.

ac-01 done. rfc_3339 widened to ^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2} ?([+-]\d{2}:\d{2}|[+-]\d{4}|Z)$ — adds optional SPACE + colon-less [+-]\d{4} offset. Evidence: real corpus rfc_3339 agreement-column shapes (digits masked) are dominated by '99:99:99 -9999'/'99:99:99 +9999' (space before colon-less offset) = the ac-04 fixture form. duckdb-verified: this form does NOT round-trip via strptime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S%z') (returns NULL), so the AC's 'no transform change needed' holds for the GATE (CompiledValidator.is_valid + eval gate are JSON-Schema/pattern only, no strptime) but the validate VERB would materialise these as NULL. Materialisation round-trip for space-form rfc_3339 = separate follow-up, out of scope (spec is gate/veto). time.iso pattern \.\d{1,6}$ + minLength 10/maxLength 15; hms_24h (\.\d+)?$ + maxLength 15; year ^\d{4}(\.0+)?$. All 240 types pass alignment 100%; 4 fixtures validate.

ac-02 done. Case-fold enum membership in BOTH validators, scoped to enum only. Rust (crates/finetype-core/src/validator.rs): new compile_schema_parts() strips 'enum' from the jsonschema blob and stores a lower-cased HashSet enum_folded; is_valid/validate check value.to_lowercase() membership manually after the jsonschema pattern/length check — so any co-attached pattern stays byte-exact on the raw value. Eval gate (scripts/apply_ydf_validation_gate.py): _compile_spec lower-cases enum_set; passes() compares value.lower(). Fold = to_lowercase()/str.lower() (Unicode lowercasing; the enum sets in play are ASCII so this == casefold). Verified: http_method 'gET' and country_code 'us' STILL reject (byte-exact pattern), proving the scope; day_of_week thursday/THURSDAY and gender male/Male now pass. Unit test ac02_enum_case_fold added; existing ac07_http_method_case_variants (byte-exact) still green (67 validator tests pass). 'Only ADDS matches' holds for the enum direction.

ac-03 done (doc + enum sourcing). gender -> HL7 FHIR AdministrativeGender enum [male,female,other,unknown] + references link; replaces self-labelled-illustrative 6-value list. DELIBERATE narrowing: drops 'Non-binary'/'Prefer not to say' (FHIR maps those to 'other'/'unknown') — this REMOVES matches (counter to ac-02's only-ADDS), so ac-05 must confirm gender does not regress >10%; if it does, revisit. gender_code -> converted pattern ^[MFX]$ to enum [M,F,X,0,1,2,9]: ICAO Doc 9303 alpha (M/F/X) + ISO/IEC 5218 numeric (0/1/2/9), both references added; description corrected (was wrongly claiming O valid — ICAO uses X). Converted to enum (not kept as pattern) because 'case-insensitive per ac-02' only flows through the enum fold, not a byte-exact pattern. Generator updated (gender mixed-case FHIR values to exercise fold; gender_code adds 0/1/2/9). All 240 types pass alignment 100% after release rebuild.

ac-04: added hidden 'finetype validate-value -l <label> <value>' subcommand (backed by validate_value_for_label/CompiledValidator — same validator profile veto uses) + scripts/validation_parity.py (14-value fixture). Surfaced + closed one residual divergence: hms_24h pattern allowed unbounded fractional digits but maxLength capped at 15, so the length-skipping eval gate and the length-enforcing Rust validator disagreed on long-fractional values. Reconciled by bounding the pattern to (\.\d{1,6})? (matches time.iso microsecond bound; pattern max length now == maxLength 15). Parity holds across all 14; 240/240 alignment retained.

ac-05: false-veto sweep (scripts/false_veto_sweep.py, 1.27M agreement cols) before->after. day_of_week 70.2->10.7%, gender 22.3->5.2%, year 32.6->0.4%, time.iso 88.4->2.3%, hms_24h 35.8->0.7%, rfc_3339 93.6->2.6%. Zero clean-validation regressions. The sweep surfaced 3 residuals needing further real-world widening beyond ac-01: time.iso fractional 6->9 digits (.NET 100ns/nanosecond, maxLength 15->18); hms_24h single-digit hour \d{1,2} (minLength 8->7); day_of_week +EN 3-letter abbreviations (Mon..Sun). day_of_week's residual 10.7% is CORRECT vetoes — 11/13 vetoed cols are the category token 'Weekday' (not a day), 2 are night-compounds; validation-attributable false-veto ~0%, so adding them would breach the Precision Principle. Artefacts: output/false-veto-sweep/{report.md,veto_rate_delta.json} (sanitised). Parity (ac-04) re-verified 16/16; alignment 240/240.

investigation scope [ac-06]: crates/finetype-cli/src/main.rs (cmd_profile + Profile output shapes), crates/finetype-core/src/{validator.rs (CompiledValidator/validate_value_for_label, taxonomy.get_validator), taxonomy.rs}, the ColumnClassifier/ColumnConfig profile entry, sweep artefact output/false-veto-sweep/veto_rate_delta.json for the audited-safe allowlist derivation.

ac-06 output-shape + default-on: validation-as-veto ships DEFAULT-ON in profile, with --no-validation-veto escape hatch. New JSON fields per column: validation_pass_rate (when the predicted type has an applicable validation), validation_vetoed + vetoed_type (when a HARD veto fired — predicted label NULLed to 'unknown'), validation_advisory_low (sub-threshold but type not audited-safe). Plain output annotates '⊘ vetoed:<type> (N% pass)' or '⚠ low-pass N% (advisory)'. HARD veto scoped to the 69 audited-safe labels in labels/veto_safe.txt (generated by scripts/false_veto_sweep.py: real validation + >=20 agreement cols + <10% after-fix false-veto, plus day_of_week exception); the ~152 unmeasured types get advisory-only, never a hard NULL. Threshold 0.5 matches ydf_prediction_gated. Verified: year/email hard-vetoed on failing values, utc-offset advisory-only, --no-validation-veto emits zero validation fields; 237 core+cli tests pass, alignment 240/240, parity 16/16.

ac-07: MADR choice 0091 written (.orbit/choices/0091-validation-as-veto-asymmetric-signal.yaml), status accepted. Captures the three decisions: (1) validation is ASYMMETRIC (reliable NO, unreliable YES) → validation-as-veto ships DEFAULT-ON in profile scoped to audited-safe labels, YES-side disambiguation stays blocked on rare-type training data per spec 2026-06-04 INCONCLUSIVE; (2) case-fold enums SCOPED to membership only — co-attached patterns stay byte-exact; (3) gender enums sourced to FHIR AdministrativeGender / ICAO 9303 / ISO 5218 with references. Verification block cites sweep deltas, parity 16/16, alignment 240/240.
